messages:
maria (support): Heads-up — Customer 'AcmeVideo' opened an escalation: intermittent 401s + high tail latency. They see requests to us-east1 and eu-west1 for the same user session within seconds. Billing shows duplicate token usage. Any ideas? :thinking:

tom (customer): repro steps: using our Node SDK, defaults. They call generate many times; on a timeout the SDK retries to another region. Sometimes the second request returns 401 while the first later succeeds. We see X-Region: eu-west1 then X-Region: us-east1 in logs.

maria (support): here's a trimmed log trace (redacted):

```
[1972000000.123] req_id=abc123 region=eu-west1 status=504 client-id=acct-42
[1972000001.456] req_id=abc123 region=us-east1 status=401 auth=invalid_token
[1972000003.789] req_id=abc123 region=eu-west1 status=200 duration=670ms
```

maria (support): SDK config they sent (snippet):

```
client = new RedwoodClient({
  regionFallback: ['eu-west1','us-east1'],
  hedgedRequests: true,
  hedgedTimeoutMs: 500,
  maxAttempts: 2,
  backoffJitter: 'full'
})
```

aj (eng-runtime): thanks — looks like client-side hedging + aggressive fallback. A couple thoughts: 1) When a hedged retry goes to a different region, the client currently reuses the same short-lived bearer token. If token TTL is very short or there's clock skew, the second attempt can hit auth failure. 2) Billing duplicates can happen if requests are both accepted and completed by different regions before de-dup is applied.

aj (eng-runtime): can you confirm the token TTL and whether the SDK refreshes token per attempt? Also please capture these headers on both attempts: `X-Region`, `X-Request-Id`, `Authorization`, and `X-Received-At` (server timestamp).

dina (support): I reproduced locally with customer's config. Observations: when hedgedTimeoutMs=500, the client issues the second request ~520ms after first. The second attempt carries same Authorization header. On our staging auth service there was a ~1s clock skew for some tokens, causing the second request to be rejected with 401 while the primary later succeeded. :warning:

maria (support): got it. Customer also complained of duplicate billing because both attempts sometimes completed and charged.

aj (eng-runtime): mitigation plan:
- short term: ask customer to disable cross-region hedging or set `hedgedRequests: false` (fast) OR increase `hedgedTimeoutMs` to be > token validation window.
- medium: SDK patch to refresh token per attempt and attach an `Idempotency-Key` derived from client-side request ID so server can dedupe billing.
- long: server-side: add region-affinity TTL per token and more robust token-clock-tolerance checks.

aj (eng-runtime): quick repro command for support to capture headers (curl):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Client-Id: acct-42" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?region=eu-west1" \
  --trace-ascii -
```

maria (support): I'm going to send a hotfix message to the customer: recommend toggling hedgedRequests off while we prepare SDK patch. Also requesting their token TTL and SDK version.

tom (customer): thanks — toggled hedgedRequests=false and tail latency normalized. No duplicate charges observed in next 10 minutes. We'll wait for the SDK patch and idempotency header.

ci-bot: New issue created: RNW-4567 "SDK: refresh token per hedged-attempt + idempotency key" assigned to eng-runtime.

aj (eng-runtime): I'll own RNW-4567. Plan: add per-attempt token refresh, attach `X-Idempotency-Key`, and default `regionAffinity: true` in next SDK minor release. Will add telemetry hooks so support can easily surface multi-region attempts.

maria (support): action items for support: 1) Ask customers with hedgedRequests enabled to temporarily disable. 2) Collect header traces if they opt-in to testing. 3) Notify billing ops to watch potential duplicate charges for affected accounts.

dina (support): adding note to escalation: customer accepted temporary change. Waiting for SDK patch ETA from @aj. :eyes:

aj (eng-runtime): ETA: branch by EOD, internal QA in 2 days, staged rollout next week. Will post PR link here.
